name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Adds one-click API RESPONSE DIAGNOSTIC for the active Group row without importing posts or running AI.
Diagnostic compares URL+sorting, UID+sorting, and URL-default requests for get_list_fb_group_posts.
Captures HTTP status, latency, response bytes, top-level keys, candidate post arrays, cursor paths, and before/after unwrap counts.
If a cursor is found, a PAGE2 probe is executed automatically to verify real pagination.
Classifies likely root cause as unwrap cursor loss, parser mismatch, UID mode, sorting parameter issue, upstream one-post/no-cursor, or unknown.
Writes structured diagnostics newest-first to the NHẬT KÝ API sheet. Raw post text and full cursor tokens are not persisted.
Normal W1 scan/import business logic remains unchanged during this diagnostic phase.
